Name: (CP) Fortune Teller Specifies Daily Luck
Author: HeadInTheCloudsMods
Description:
When interacting with the TV's fortune channel to get your daily luck, Welwick will specify the exact value of your daily luck modifier! That's pretty much it.

Has compatibility for the following languages:

[*]English (this one I did lmao)[/*]
[*]German (thank you to an anonymous person on the SDV sever and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/VoidWitchCult]@VoidWitchCult[/url] for the translation!)[/*]
[*]Spanish (thanks to my dad, love you)[/*]
[*]French (thanks to Mr. Duck aka [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/xyariaa]@xyariaa[/url])[/*]
[*]Portuguese (thanks to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/frontboarder]@frontboarder[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/CheshiresAtelier]@CheshiresAtelier[/url])[/*]
